tara: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window publish for Python + TS SDKs in ~30m. Goal: canary -> smoke -> GA. Will sign artifacts and push release notes after GA.
kevin: Ack. Which packages and versions? any pin strategy for downstream customers?
tara: python @redwood/sdk-python v2.1.0, ts @redwood/sdk v2.1.0. We want to pin legacy sync clients (v1.x) in the docs as deprecated, not force-pinned in package.json.
sam: +1 but let's not auto-deprecate until we have the deprecation blurb ready. I can draft. Also we should gate publishing on the integration smoke tests passing.
deploy-bot: publish job queued: `publish-sdk:py-ts:1917902468`
kevin: Add an explicit canary tag first (2.1.0-canary.2026-03-20). If canary fails, we rollback and do not promote. Can we set an automatic 30m hold before GA promotion?
tara: Yes — manual hold required. We'll only promote after manual thumbs from eng and docs.
nora: Quick checklist: build artifacts, signatures, changelog entry, compatibility note for existing token format, and ensure examples in docs updated. I can take changelog + examples.
alice-docs: I'll prepare the deprecation language and a short migration snippet for the sync->async client. Drop it in #docs-review before GA.
sam: Running prerelease smoke: `./scripts/smoke_integration.sh --canary 2.1.0-canary.2026-03-20`
deploy-bot: canary publish started for @redwood/sdk-python:2.1.0-canary.2026-03-20 and @redwood/sdk:2.1.0-canary.2026-03-20
sam: smoke logs: failures around timeout in auth refresh, investigating. stack trace pasted to thread: ```Error: token refresh 504 from auth.redwood.net at /lib/auth/refresh.js:84```
kevin: If it's auth timeouts only in CI, try increasing timeout and re-run. If it reproduces locally we should rollback the canary and halt GA.
tara: Hold GA. Sam please repro locally and confirm fix before re-run. Nora/Alice — hold on publishing release notes until we get a green canary.
sam: repro'd locally, root cause is a config in our test harness. Pushing a fix to branch release/2.1.0-fix-auth then re-running smoke. ETA 20m.
kevin: Good catch. If smoke passes after fix, we do manual promote and I will run the GA publish command and notify ops for token cache bump.
tara: Plan B if we see regressions: rollback canary and mark release as delayed, update release notes with a note "delayed due to auth refresh instability" and schedule new quiet-window next weekday.
alice-docs: Noted. I'll prepare a short blurb ready to insert if needed.
deploy-bot: canary publish failed for @redwood/sdk-python:2.1.0-canary.2026-03-20 — job exit code 1
sam: fixed and re-ran — canary smoke now passing locally. Rerunning CI canary now.
kevin: Once CI passes, I'll cut GA but will not unpin legacy package docs until docs-review signoff.
tara: Thanks all. After GA, we'll attach release notes and deprecation schedule. Leaving this thread for final thumbs — please react with :thumbsup: when you approve promotion.
kevin: :thumbsup:
cole: :thumbsup: (added after the fact)
